name: Superintendent of Public Instruction of California

constituents.basis: 2020 Census resident population of California (whole state)

term_limit.value: Two terms (Cal. Const. art. IX, sec. 2); nonpartisan office elected at each gubernatorial election

notes: No powers sentence was sourced. The usual description (head of the California Department of Education) was not confirmed in this session. Education funding context, which the SPI does not adopt: the 2026-27 Proposition 98 K-14 minimum guarantee is about $128.0B per the Budget Act (CSBA summary) or $128.1B per the LAO (Oct. 9, 2026). This is set by the Legislature and Governor, not the CDE's own budget, so it is left out of facts. ACA 9 (2023) proposed making the office appointed and cancelling the 2026 election; since the office is on the Nov. 2026 ballot, it evidently was not enacted (not verified directly). graph.civlab.org: not reachable.
